 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sunil Kumar Panwar
 Oral Order
2 22-05-2023 Learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to add the informant is opposite party no.2 in course of the day.

Issue notice to opposite party no.2, for which requisites etc. must be filed with both the processes,
under ordinary process as well as registered cover with A/D within one week.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned APP for the State.
The petitioner has prayed for regular bail in a case registered for the offence punishable under sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
As per allegation in FIR, the petitioner and others did not execute the land in question in favour of the informant in spite of receiving amount of Rs. 2,50,000/- from him.

Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.21943 of 2023(2) dt.22-05-2023 Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence.
He has falsely been implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that it is case of civil in nature for which criminal proceeding has been initiated against the petitioner.
He has got no criminal antecedent and languishing in judicial custody since 7.10.2022.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, the petitioner is ready to settle the dispute and deposit the amount i.e. 2,50,000/- Rs. to the informant.
Learned APP appearing for the state has opposed the prayer of regular bail.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the fact that petitioner is ready to make payment of the said amount, this court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on Provisional bail.

The above named petitioner is directed to be released on provisional bail in connection with Sugauli P.S. Case No. 352 of 2021 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., East Champaran.
Put up this case on 28.7.2023.
(Sunil Kumar Panwar, J) Amandeep/-
